messages:
irene: Heads up — automated image scan found a new OS vuln in the base image (CVE-2026-1234). Planning a forced base image rebuild for all runtime pools tonight 23:00 UTC. Need RBAC and KMS checks. Details: https://internal.redwood/scan/4021 :warning:
sam: cc @alex @maria — impact on Dedicated pools? Will we need node-side key access for pulling signed images?
alex: For Dedicated, pulls come from internal registry with signed manifests. KMS is used for secrets decryption, not pulls. But registry will require a rotated signing key for the new images.
maria: Security: we need audit logging of pull signatures + an RBAC role to restrict who can push signed images. Also wire image-scanner webhooks to the triage channel.
sam: Can we canary rebuild on a low-traffic pool (pool-canary-3) first? If something breaks rollback should be fast.
irene: Yes. Canary at 23:00, full rollout at 02:00 if green. @sre-oncall you'll be paged for any pod restarts >5% in 15m.
sre-oncall: ack — I'll mute expected churn alerts and watch for regressions. Provide a rollback image tag please.
alex: I'll publish new base image as `redwood/base:v2026-03-20-secfix`. Pushing signed manifest via the `registry-signer` job.
maria: RBAC change: create role `image-publisher` and bind to infra group, allow `registry:write` only on `redwood/*`. Add audit policy to capture `image.signature.*` events.
irene: KMS snippet for the deploy job (use after image build):
```
kubectl create secret generic registry-kms \\n  --from-literal=key=projects/redwood/kms/keys/registry-signing
```
sam: Note: runtime agents must accept new signature algorithm `ed25519`. Old nodes missing libs will fail verify. Need compatibility shim or rolling agent update.
maria: We can ship shim in agent v1.14.2. @alex can we schedule node reboot window?
alex: Rolling reboot via `cluster-upgrade` job. I'll start with canary nodes then workers. ETA start 23:30.
irene: Vulnerability triage: severity high, exploit complexity low. Mark scan as paranoid. @security-bot please tag findings and open a tracking ticket.
security-bot: Created S-4021: "CVE-2026-1234 - base image glibc update" and assigned to @maria — https://jira.redwood/browse/S-4021
sam: If rollback needed use `redwood/base:v2026-03-15`. Ensure we keep the old signed manifest in the registry before deleting.
irene: Also: KMS key-rotate window is at 01:30 UTC. DO NOT rotate until after successful rollout or signature validation will break.
sre-oncall: Runbooks updated. I'll escalate to oncall lead if error rate >1% after 30m post-deploy.
maria: Postmortem owners: infra + security. Capture metrics: signature verification failures, token latency, cold-start rate.
alex: I'll post deploy job logs to #incidents and spin up a short status thread there.
sam: Thanks team. I'll be on standby from 22:45 UTC. :thumbsup:
irene: Final checklist: canary image built and signed, RBAC role created, audit policy deployed, agent shim rolled to canaries, restart scheduled, KMS hold until confirm. Anything missing?
maria: Remediation snippet for stuck pods: `kubectl patch deployment <d> -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"recreate":"$(date +%s)"}}}}}'` — I'll prepare a small script in case.
irene: Good — closing plan here. Ping this thread if blockers.
